text:
maya: hit a weird onboarding snag — followed the Node quickstart, firstcall returns a 403 with \"tenant_blocked\". local curl works, but the sample app (uses SDK v0.9) retries a couple times then shows a generic error card. no link to billing.

praveen: can you paste the raw response body and headers? curious if the SDK is sending X-Redwood-Tenant or the old X-Redwood-Org header.

maya: body:
```json
{"error":"Tenant not authorized","code":"tenant_blocked"}
```
headers: the SDK sent X-Redwood-Tenant: wz-abc123 but our gateway expects X-Redwood-Org for older tenant checks.

eli: ah — SDK v0.9 flipped to X-Redwood-Tenant for multi-tenant routing, but our gateway fallback path still checks X-Redwood-Org for billing state in some regions. mismatch can route to anon tenant.

infra-zoe: that explains why local curl worked (i set X-Redwood-Org manually) but the sample failed. two DX issues: 1) mismatch between sample image (bundled SDK) and README which mentions REDWOOD_ORG; 2) SDK retry logic hides the hint by retrying before surfacing the message.

maya: exactly. the app retries 2x, then shows spinner and finally error. I never saw the billing-bot note that would have helped.

devex: proposals: - quickstart image: pin SDK to a tested version in the Dockerfile or make the entrypoint print effective SDK version and headers on startup (non-sensitive) - SDK: short-circuit retries for 403 tenant_blocked when no org header matches gateway expectations and include an appended hint: \"Workspace may require billing setup. Set REDWOOD_ORG or X-Redwood-Org, or visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<id>/billing\" - docs: update quickstart README to call out SDK/header mismatch gotcha and how to override headers in containers.

praveen: for the SDK change we should detect both header names; if code == 'tenant_blocked' and retries > 0, return immediately with the hint instead of retrying ephemeral errors. i'll open a small change.

infra-zoe: i'll update the quickstart Dockerfile to either pin the SDK or `npm ci` from a lockfile, and add an entrypoint echo that prints SDK version and effective REDWOOD_ORG/X-Redwood-Org header. example: `echo \"SDK: $(node -p \"require('./package.json').dependencies['@redwood/sdk']\")\"` and `env | grep REDWOOD`. non-blocking but very helpful.

billing-bot: Notice: workspace wz-abc123 requires billing contact. Admins visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/wz-abc123/billing to add payment/contact info.

maya: after praveen's tip i pinned SDK in my local test and set REDWOOD_ORG, container worked. thanks.

devex: filing tasks: quickstart-pin-sdk, sdk-no-retry-on-tenant-block, docs-header-gotcha. will link PRs and add a short note to the welcome email: \"If your first call fails, check SDK version and REDWOOD_ORG / X-Redwood-Org.\"

praveen: small SDK PR incoming with unit tests for retry behavior.

infra-zoe: PR incoming to quickstart with startup checks and README blurb. will make CI fail-fast if SDK mismatch detected.

maya: closing loop — container now returns first successful call after pin + env fix. appreciate the quick triage. :raised_hands:
